model_annotation:
This graph displays the daily number of new COVID-19 cases and the number of related news reports over time. The horizontal axis shows dates from July 1, 2022, to August 26, 2022, with no apparent specific ordering or grouping of the dates. The left vertical axis represents the number of people, with a range of 0 to 1,800,000 and labeled tick marks at intervals of 200,000. The right vertical axis indicates the number of news reports, with a range of 0 to 6,000 and labeled tick marks at intervals of 1,000. 

The graph features teal bars representing the daily number of new confirmed cases, with values approximately ranging from 400,000 to 1,700,000. The shortest bar is around 400,000, and the tallest bar is around 1,700,000. A blue line represents the number of COVID-19-related news reports, fluctuating between approximately 1,000 and 4,000. No bars or lines are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
